answer: Sponsor-liable invite trees put real bond at risk on every new seat. A seat may invite at most 3 newcomers per epoch; each invitee ties 25% of the sponsor's 2,000 POA bond to later clone proofs against that invitee. A farm of 300 fakes needs 100 distinct sponsor-epochs and puts 50,000 POA of sponsor bonds at risk, and those bonds cannot be pooled because each slash hits one sponsor address. An honest sponsor invites a few real seats that train a vineyard trellis model, grade an onyx gem cut, or price a nectar harvest, and keeps the bond.
